biotools.summary: A knowledge distillation method (KD) designed to improve genomic survival prediction accuracy by rectifying supervision bias inherent in censored data. The tool leverages combined power of rectified censored data and uncensored data for cancer research.
biotools.name: KD: Knowledge Distillation Method for Genomic Survival Analysis
